title: How to Write Your First OpenClaw Skill: A Complete Guide
summary: Step-by-step tutorial for writing a custom OpenClaw skill from scratch. Covers skill.yaml, triggers, tasks, and how to deploy your skill to ClawHub.
body_markdown: Declare the` web_search` capability to make HTTP requests to external URLs, or use OpenClaw's named integration capabilities (` calendar_read` ,` email_read` , etc.) for common services. For custom APIs without a named capability, use` http_request` and configure the API credentials in your agent's secrets store — then reference them via` {{secret.MY_API_KEY}}` in your IDENTITY instructions.
